senses.gloss:
अयुक्त a.
—1 Not yoked or harnessed; अरश्मानो येऽरथा अयुक्ता Rv. 9. 97. 20.
—2 Not joined, united or connected.
—3 Not devout or pious, inattentive, negligent. नास्तिबुद्धिरयुक्तस्य
 Bg. 2. 66; अयुक्तासो अब्रह्मता यदसन् Rv. 5. 33. 3.
—4 Unpractised, unused, unemployed; ˚बुद्धि, ˚चार.
—5 Unfit, improper, unsuitable; अयुक्तोऽयं निर्देशः P. IV. 2. 64. Mbh.
—6 Untrue, wrong.
—7 Unmarried.
—8 Opening externally.
—9 Reduced to straits, miserable.
.━{@Comp.@}: अयुक्तकर्मन्, अयुक्तकृत्, अयुक्तपदार्थः, अयुक्तरूप

आयुक्त p. p.
—1 Appointed, charged with (with gen. or loc.); ये तत्र ब्राह्मणाः संमर्शिनः
 युक्ता आयुक्ताः T. Up. 1. 11. 4. कुशलोऽन्वेषणस्याहमायुक्तो दूतकर्मणि Bk. 8. 115.
—2 United, joined, obtained.
अयुक्त + -कर्मन् m. an official (perhaps for आयुक्त˚).
अयुक्त + -कृत् a. doing improper or wrong acts.
अयुक्त + -पदार्थः the sense of a word to be supplied, as the sense of अपि q. v.
अयुक्त + -रूप a. incongruous, unsuitable; ˚पं किमतःपरं वद Ku. 5. 69.

अयुक्तिः f.
—1 Disunion, separation.
—2 Unreasonableness, want of conformity to correct principles.
—3 Unfitness, impropriety, incongruity.

अयुज a.
—1 Having no equal or companion. अयुजो असमो नृभिरेकः Rv. 8. 62. 2.
—2 Separate, single, odd.

अयुत a.
—1 Disjoined, detached, not connected.
—2 Uninterrupted, undisturbed. Av. 19. 51. 1.

आयुत a.
—1 Mixed, mingled.
—2 Melted.

अयुद्ध a. Ved.
—1 Not fighting.
—2 Unconquered, irresistible. अयुद्ध इद् युधा वृतम् Rv. 8. 45. 3.

अयुधः A non-combatant.

आयुधः, -धम्
 [आयुध्-घञ्र्थे क]
—1 A weapon, shield &c.; it is of 3 kinds (1) प्रहरण, e. g.

—2 A vessel (Ved.).

अयुध्य a. Unconquerable, irresistible दुश्च्यवनः पृतनाषाळयुध्यो

अयुव a.
—1 Undisturbed, unshaken.
—2 Unconnected.
अयुवमारिन् a. Where no young people die. Ait. Br.
आयु a. [इ-ठण् Uṇ. 1. 2] Ved. Living, going, movable.

आयु + .{@-युः@}
—1 A living being, man.
—2 Mankind, human race.
—3 Living beings taken collectively.
—4 The first man.
—5 Life, duration of life.

—7 A son, descendant, offspring.
—8 The son of Purūravas and Urvaśī.

आयुस् n. [इ-असि-णिच्च Uṇ. 2. 117] —1 Life, duration of life;
 दीर्घमायुः R. 9. 62, 12. 48; तक्षकेणापि
[]
 दष्टस्य आयुर्मर्माणि रक्षति H. 2. 16; आयुर्वर्षशतं नृणां परिमितम्
 Bh. 3. 107, शतायुर्वै पुरुषः Ait. Br.; प्राणो हि भूतानामायुः । तस्मात्सर्वायुषमुच्यते
 सर्वमेव त आयुर्यान्ति T. Up. 2. 3. 1.
—2 Vital power.
—3 Food.
—4 N. of a ceremony called आयुष्टोम performed to secure long life,
 together with the गो and ज्योतिस् part of the अभिप्लव ceremony.
 (In comp. the final स् of this word is changed to ष् before hard
 consonants, and to र् before soft ones).

आयुस् + -वेदः [आयुरस्मिन् विद्यतेऽनेन वा आयुर्विंदतीत्यायुर्वेदः Suśr.]
 the science of health or medicine, counted as a sacred science, and regarded
 as a supplement to the Atharvaveda; [it comprises 8 different departments;
 (1) शल्यम् surgery; (2) शालाक्यम् diagnosis of diseases belonging
 to the head and its organs; (3) कायचिकित्सा treatment of diseases
 of the whole body; (4) भूतविद्या treatment of diseases of the mind
 supposed to be caused by the influence of evil spirits; (5) कौमारभृत्यम्
 treatment of children; (6) अगदतन्त्रम् doctrine of antidotes; (7)
 रसायनतन्त्रम् doctrine of elixirs; and (8) वाजीकरणतन्त्रम्
 treatment of remedies to increase generative power]; Śukra. 4. 277.

आयुष्मत् a. [आयुस् मतुप्]
—1 Alive, living.
—2 Long-lived; आयुष्मन्तं सुतं सूते Ms. 3. 263. (Generally used in
 dramas by elderly persons in addressing a nobly-born person; e. g.
 a charioteer addresses a prince as आयुष्मन्. A Brāhmaṇa is also so
 addressed in saluting; cf. Ms. 2. 125; आयुष्मान् भव सौम्येति वाच्यो विप्रोऽभिवादने).
—3 Lasting; गायन्ति पृथगायुष्मन्निदं नो वक्तुमर्हसि Bhāg. 11. 22. 3.
—4 Old. ━m.
—1 The third of the 27 Yogas or divisions of the ecliptic.
—2 The Yoga star कृत्तिका; the third lunar mansion.
आयुषम् (At the end of a few comps.) Life; e. g. पुरुषायुषजीविन्यः R. 1. 63.

आयुष्कः [आयुः कायते, कै-क Tv.]
—1 That which proclaims age or duration of life.
—2 (With Jainas) Connection with the body or person.

आयुष्य a. [आयुः प्रयोजनमस्य, यत्] Promoting long life,
